name: Dwarf_City_Level_1_Hex_V1
display_name: Centro da Cidade Anã — Nível I
origin: center of footprint on ground Z=0
scale: Native map units; pointy-top hex tile radius 1, foundation radius .84. Fits independent fortification ring; asset only, no game integration.
design: Dwarf city I of four: squat broad granite council hall, huge square pilasters with copper rune inlays, long stepped dark slate vault bound in copper, one low roof lantern and large hammer civic badge. Founders bronze anvil monument, stone bench and water cistern in open forecourt. No perimeter walls. Tall towers, extra halls and grand roof volumes reserved for levels II–IV.
notes: Studio and scale reference excluded from export. Separate editable source parts; consolidated game meshes by architectural group.
faction_tint: Sapphire civic cloth isolated in Faction mesh for future owner-color integration. Copper, roof, masonry and amber lights keep their own colors; no runtime changes.
